svg.title: DamHopper Android Agent Hub First Page - 3-Column Expanded Tablet Layout (>=840dp)
svg.desc: Expanded tablet and foldable landscape landing page showcasing the 3-column architecture: Left Agents Section (observed agents with filter chips and jump actions), Center Stage Project List (active cards, live terminals, zero-session dismissible targets), and Right Workspace File Tree (selected project explorer, file changes, and quick editor open).
